race.comment: DEBATING (3) has the clearest winning profile after controlling the race as favourite and beating Sass by two lengths at this track over 1200m. Gets the claim and could prove hard to beat. WARREGO (4) is the main danger, having come out of SC grade at this venue with a dominant win over Mistifyzou despite racing wide, and his record at the distance is a strong supporting point. Include. FIELD OF PRAISE (10) has been costly from a winning view but keeps finding the frame, with three placings from four starts this season and enough track-and-trip grounding to stay in the argument. A must for wider plays. MODS (8) resumed with a sound third behind Tokyo Bandit after beginning slowly and racing keenly, and his distance record gives him a genuine each-way chance if he takes improvement second-up. SI SENORA (9) resumes after 12 weeks. Rates among the each-way chances fresh.
